newsitem.title: USA: Versa sees full-year results up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Versa sees full-year results up slightly.

text.p: Versa Technologies Inc chairman James Mohrhauser said the company expects its current fiscal year earnings to be up slightly over the prior year.

"Exclusive of the one-time charge to earnings due to the divestiture of our thermoplastic business in the second quarter, and despite continued weakness with our Engineered Materials businesses, we expect earnings per share for the year to be up slightly over the prior year," he said.
For the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996, the company reported earnings of $0.99 a share on sales of $70.7 million.

"With the acquisition of Eder Industries Inc on October 30, 1996 and the significant growth of our fluid power segment, Versa Technologies has moved more toward the manufacture of higher value-added engineered systems versus components," Mohrhauser said in a statement.
The company, which posted third-quarter earnings of $0.22 a share on sales of $22.1 million, has three business segments -- fluid power, engineered materials and electronics.
